step1_analysis.description: A preamplifier stage for a flash ADC comparator. It is designed to amplify the difference between the differential input signal and the differential reference voltage. Note: The provided netlist appears to have an extraction artifact where all input pair drains are shorted to VOUT_MINUS, which would result in zero AC gain in simulation.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the preamplifier stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current Id = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.7-0.42)^2 = 105 uA. Two tails = 210 uA. Power = 1.8V * 210uA = 378 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters with Vbias=0.7V. Much lower than the 500mW reported for the entire ADC chip.

dc_gain.description: Low frequency voltage gain from differential input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_in = 550 uA/V, gm_load = 328 uA/V. Ideal differential gain = gm_in / gm_load = 1.67 V/V (4.5 dB). Due to shorted drains in netlist, actual AC gain will be near 0 (<-100 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist connects all input drains to VOUT_MINUS, causing the differential AC currents to cancel perfectly. A properly wired version would have ~4.5 dB gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout = 1/(2*gm_load) = 1.5 kOhm. Cout ~ 15 fF. BW = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cout) = 7 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The low gain and diode-connected loads result in a very wide bandwidth, suitable for the 1.3 GHz operation reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, and transient response of the comparator preamplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Comparator Preamplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xmsw=5u L_xmsw=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VVREF_PLUS VREF_PLUS 0 0.9
VVREF_MINUS VREF_MINUS 0 0.9
VVIN_PLUS VIN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
VVIN_MINUS VIN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -1
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 10p 10p 400p 1n)

XM1 VOUT_MINUS VREF_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOUT_MINUS VOUT_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT_MINUS VIN_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT_MINUS VOUT_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUT_MINUS VIN_MINUS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VOUT_MINUS VREF_MINUS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XMSW VOUT_MINUS CLK VOUT_MINUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmsw} w={W_xmsw}

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(VOUT_MINUS)

ac dec 10 1Meg 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_MINUS)
meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1Meg

tran 10p 2n
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT_MINUS)
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT_MINUS)
quit
.endc
.end
